# graph-databases

Vendor-neutral graph-database access - Gremlin, openCypher and SPARQL shapes (bounded results, stopped loops, labeled fan-out, anchored starts, bounded paths, parameterized text) measured on data.graph.query facts by model graph-access.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model graph-access --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model graph-explain --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model graphql --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show graph-databases`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-DATA-013, AF-GDB-001, AF-GDB-002, AF-GDB-003, AF-GDB-004, AF-GDB-005, AF-GDB-006, AF-GDB-007, AF-GDB-008, AF-GDB-025
